news.headline: Invivyd Announces Positive DECLARATION Trial Data for Monoclonal Antibody VYD2311, and Ushers in a New Era for Immunization
news.body: VYD2311 (ibramvibart) achieved high, durable antiviral activity predictive of 70-90% protection from symptomatic COVID-19 infection for both single- and multi-dose intramuscular arms Highly attractive safety and tolerability profile observed for single- and multi-dose VYD2311 arms, supporting broad population usePositive dialogue with U.S. FDA and HHS leadership has resulted in progress toward regulatory consistency between Invivyd monoclonal antibodies and related vaccines (e.g., COVID-19). Based on FDA feedback, upon planned VYD2311 BLA submission, Invivyd anticipates review for accelerated approval either by, or with input from, CBERInvivyd anticipates submitting a BLA based on DECLARATION and LIBERTY data to FDA in Q1 2027Investor call to be held at 8:30 am EST on November 23, 2026 NEW HAVEN, Conn., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Invivyd, Inc. (Nasdaq: IVVD) today announced all interim analysis primary and secondary endpoints were met in the DECLARATION Phase 3 trial of VYD2311 (ibramvibart). VYD2311, administered via intramuscular injection (IM), demonstrated high and durable antiviral activity, consistent with Invivyd’s target 70-90% protection from RT-PCR confirmed symptomatic COVID-19, versus placebo. VYD2311 demonstrated an overall highly attractive safety and tolerability profile in both single- and multi-dose arms. Invivyd intends to submit a Biologics License Application (BLA) seeking accelerated approval of VYD2311 for the prevention of symptomatic COVID-19 based on the positive interim analysis of the Phase 3 DECLARATION trial and the supportive data from the Phase 3 LIBERTY trial comparing VYD2311 and an mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccine.

Two firefighters died battling the flames in a Bordeaux suburb.

logs.summary:
Cyclone Arnab has intensified over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to make landfall near the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, with sustained winds reaching up to 140 km/h, classified as a very severe cyclonic storm. Heavy rainfall is anticipated in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, prompting authorities to prepare for large-scale evacuations.
Andhra Pradesh is preparing to evacuate approximately 5.7 lakh people from vulnerable areas, and schools in Odisha have been closed as Cyclone Arnab approaches. West Bengal and other eastern states are on alert, with authorities coordinating response measures. The India Meteorological Department has issued specific district‑level warnings.

logs.summary: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck the Banda Sea off Tual in Indonesia’s Maluku Province, with some early reports citing a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 before being revised or downgraded. Tremors were felt in parts of eastern Indonesia, including Maluku and Papua, and as far as Darwin in Australia’s Northern Territory. Authorities reported no tsunami threat and no immediate casualties or structural damage.
